headline: Content API for Shopping is now erroring — migrations are overdue
intro: First edition, re-cut to the last three months only.

items.title: Content API for Shopping now returns progressive errors
items.what: As of 1 September, requests to the legacy Content API for Shopping started failing progressively. The replacement is the Merchant API.
items.sowhat: Any client still integrated on the legacy API has a feed pipeline that is degrading right now, not at some future cut-off. Worth an integration audit across the book this week — this is the one item on this list with a live blast radius.

items.title: Merchant Center Next rollout completes — 'Feeds' are now 'Data sources'
items.what: All retailers are now upgraded to Merchant Center Next. 'Destinations' are renamed 'Marketing methods' and 'Feeds' are renamed 'Data sources'.
items.sowhat: Every onboarding deck, audit template and screenshot we use says 'Feeds'. Client-facing language needs a pass or we look a version behind in the next QBR.

items.title: Anthropic open-sources Claude Commerce Agents — with no catalogue layer
items.what: Apache-2.0 blueprints for a shopper agent and a merchant agent, deployable on Claude API, Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry and Vertex AI. The release explicitly excludes payments, catalogue and advertising.
items.sowhat: 'No catalogue' is the tell. The blueprint assumes somebody else supplies clean, structured product data for the agent to reason over — that is precisely our lane, and it is a strong hook for the AI-Ready Feeds pitch.

items.title: Google Ads opens Product Value Optimization beta
items.what: A new beta letting advertisers apply value adjustments so automated bidding optimises toward the products that matter commercially, not just the ones that convert most.
items.sowhat: A real margin lever rather than a volume one. Good candidate to trial on a retainer account where product-level profitability varies a lot — Reiss or Schuh would show the effect fastest.

items.title: Amazon extends Price History from 90 days to 365
items.what: Temporary discounts and pre-event markups now sit next to a full year of everyday-price history rather than 90 days.
items.sowhat: Pre-Black-Friday markup tactics are now visible for a whole year. Anyone planning Q4 promo pricing on Amazon needs to know the reference window changed before they set it.

items.title: Stripe extends Shared Payment Tokens to Visa and Mastercard agent rails
items.what: Shared Payment Tokens now reach Mastercard Agent Pay and Visa Intelligent Commerce, plus BNPL methods including Affirm and Klarna.
items.sowhat: The payment rails for agentic checkout are consolidating faster than the discovery layer is. Context for any client asking when they need to be ready — the plumbing will be there before the demand is.

items.title: AI Overviews appear in 24% of shopping queries — and have started softening
items.what: AI Overviews were measured on 24% of shopping queries, with presence declining slightly over recent weeks as Google appears to pull back on some product queries.
items.sowhat: A good QBR stat, with the honest caveat attached: this is not a straight line up. Worth quoting with the softening included — it reads as credible rather than hype.
